The Constitution doesn’t target law-abiding citizens.
Bad policies do.

We should be focused on criminals, not Americans exercising their rights.


National Association for Gun Rights (@gunrights)

Legal gun owners who follow the Constitution are not the problem.

They are not the cause of strife, and they commit crime at negligible rates. Yet they are targeted by laws that do not stop criminals and do not bring peace.

We have a short supply of people willing to defend the Constitution when it matters most. I won’t stop being one of them.

At a time when we’re already facing a $2 trillion deficit, proposals to add hundreds of billions more in spending should concern everyone. Our long-term threat isn’t foreign invasion, it’s the growing debt and the stability of our dollar. @CNBC

Video

We don’t have a revenue problem, we have a spending problem.

My Penny Plan would cut just 6% a year and balance the budget in five years. That’s it.

Show markets we’re serious about fiscal discipline, and the economy will respond.

Time to hold the line on spending.

Video

We must pass the SAVE America Act!


Cause of America (@CauseAmerica)

This is exactly why Cause of America was founded: corrupt voter rolls + mass mail ballots + no real ID checks = a system BUILT for abuse.

Americans are increasingly worried about the cost of health care, and they should be. Rising premiums and out-of-pocket expenses are squeezing families nationwide. My Health Marketplace for All Act empowers consumers to negotiate better rates and bring real competition back to the system.

FISA was created to spy on foreign enemies. Then Washington turned it on Americans. 

My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act stops FISA spying on Americans and forces real warrants in real courts.

Can you trust the government? Absolutely not. That's why our founding fathers created the 4th Amendment. My bill, the Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act, will create more protections to protect the right of privacy for citizens.
